facts.fact: The double cairn on the Hollow Moon's lip is called the Two Aunts by Kuhl-side shepherds ('they stand together and disagree about everything'). Ila writes it down as Kunal says it.
facts.why: needed because the name trade gives a true Neshar name each night (F462).

facts.fact: Kunal was nine when his father died. A week after the funeral his uncle Pritam took him up a ridge 'to see what would be mine', and Kunal says only 'and I came home.' He gives no more and Ila does not ask.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires 'half of nine' and his uncle on the ridge; the full story is held back.

facts.fact: Ila's father worked thirty years as a fair-copy clerk at the Taravan survey office, copying about seven hundred maps without signing any, and went blind in the left eye at fifty-nine before the office gave him a pension and a clock.
facts.why: needed because the beat gives his thirty years of unsigned copying; the figures and eye are small texture.

facts.fact: Ila's grandfather's gloves were found left on top, palms together, set square to the edge of a flat stone with the fingers pointing the way he had been walking; he was sitting whole against the stone on the slope above the third bend. Her father once said they were 'like a pair set out for the morning'.
facts.why: needed because the beat asks exactly how the gloves lay (clue C07).

facts.fact: Clause nine of the Winter Crossing Law expressly makes shared shelter on a licensed crossing lawful; Rohan and the council argued it for a week.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Ila say body warmth is no longer harbouring under the new law.
